title: Diwali clean-up opens up a growing market for home organisers
excerpt: As Diwali approaches, urban Indian households are hiring professional organizers to help them declutter and organize. Companies like Joy Factory and Messmerize report significant growth in festive bookings compared to last year. The demand for such services not only peaks during festivals but is also becoming a year-round requirement. Organizers focus on sorting belongings and creating organized spaces rather than deep cleaning homes.

title: KEC International shares in focus on Monday Oct 26 after ₹2872 cr PGCIL order win; YTD orders mark crosses ₹13.5k cr
excerpt: KEC International secured ₹2,872 crore in turnkey orders from Power Grid Corporation for 765 kV transmission lines linked to evacuating 8.5 GW of renewable energy in Gujarat. The wins mark a record for its domestic T&D business and take year-to-date order intake above ₹13,500 crore.

title: Mcap of 8 of top-10 firms erodes by Rs 1.55 lakh cr; HDFC Bank, Bajaj Fin biggest laggards
excerpt: Recently, the market witnessed a downturn, with eight of the leading firms in India suffering major valuation losses. The declines of HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance were particularly striking. The BSE Sensex plummeted by 1,605.44 points, indicating a bearish atmosphere across equities. While Tata Consultancy Services and Larsen & Toubro showed some gains, the overall trend remained negative.

ai.title_te: టాప్-10 కంపెనీలలో 8 సంస్థల మార్కెట్ క్యాపిటలైజేషన్‌లో ₹1.55 లక్ష కోట్ల నష్టం; HDFC బ్యాంక్, బజాజ్ ఫైనాన్స్ పెద్ద పతనాలు

ai.market_impact_te: NIFTY‑బ్యాంకింగ్, NIFTY‑ఫైనాన్స్ సూచీలు దిగువకు వెళ్లే అవకాశం ఉంది, మొత్తం ఇండెక్స్‌లో 0.5‑1% పతనం.
ai.impact_reason_te: బ్యాంకులు, ఫైనాన్స్ కంపెనీల మార్కెట్ క్యాప్ తగ్గడం వల్ల బంగారు బరువు తగ్గి, ఇండెక్స్ బరువు తగ్గుతుంది; పెట్టుబడిదారుల రిస్క్‑అవర్స్ తగ్గి, బీటా‑హై స్టాక్స్‌లో విక్రయ ఒత్తిడి పెరుగుతుంది.

title: Brookfield builds Qatar presence with Doha office
excerpt: Brookfield has established a new office in Doha which focuses on its global credit platform and investment opportunities. This step aims to strengthen its presence in Qatar, especially with a $20 billion AI infrastructure program in collaboration with a local company. The office will enhance access to sovereign wealth funds and institutional investors within the region. Brookfield joins other investment firms expanding their local operations to capture opportunities.

title: Bond yields rise nearly 30 bps in Oct, to raise govt's interest burden

The sharp rise in government bond yields since the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) October monetary policy review threatens to increase the government's borrowing costs and put pressure on its interest expenditure, potentially squeezing fiscal flexibility, according to experts.
Yield on the 10-year benchmark government bond rose to 7.474 per cent on October 23 from 7.193 per cent on October 6, increasing about 28 basis points, according to data compiled by PTI.
The rise in yields has been driven by elevated crude oil prices, a spike in global bond yields, tighter liquidity conditions in the Indian banking system and expectations of more interest rate hikes by the RBI, market experts said.

ai.summary: Apple, కొత్త iPhone Duo ఫోల్డబుల్ ఫోన్ కోసం అదనపు భాగాల సరఫరాను కోరుతోంది. ఇది మార్కెట్లో బలమైన డిమాండ్ సూచనగా భావించబడుతోంది.
